metadata.name: Shadow Class Tree
metadata.description: The Shadow's sigil: a dagger lying flat, point to the right. Fervour is the centre of the crossguard. The blade is the Blade limb: its two edges and its ridge, the ridge ending in Deathmark at the point and Two Marks the drop of blood falling from it. The grip is the Step limb's three bound strands, and the pommel is their keystones, Flicker at the very end. The guard is an S: the upper quillon is Evasion, bound by Slip where its fleur opens, with Riposte on the petal toward the blade and Ever Moving at the top; the lower quillon is the Path of the Kill, and Poison and Bleed is the fleur at its end. The four cuts stand in a column on the left. Positions only: every node and edge is the revised tree's.

data.name: Fervour
data.description: Kills generate Fervour: 10 for each enemy you kill, 25 for each Elite or stronger enemy you kill, and 2 for each critical strike you land. While you have this, Fervour drains at 10 per second once 4 seconds have passed since your last kill, so a pause in the killing is what empties it and a full bar means a run of quick kills.

data.name: Big Game
data.description: +2% increased damage per point against Elite and stronger enemies, whose kills fill 25 Fervour rather than 10.

data.name: Quick Recovery
data.description: +3% increased Cooldown Reduction per point for your movement skill.

data.name: Killing Pace
data.description: For 4 seconds after you kill an enemy, +1% increased Attack Speed and +1% increased Movement Speed per point, so one kill carries you to the next.

data.name: Reaper's Share
data.description: +2% increased Fervour gained from kills per point.

data.name: Held Breath
data.description: +1% increased damage per point for every full 20 Fervour you currently hold.

data.name: Slow Exhale
data.description: Fervour drains 5% slower per point once it has begun to drain.

data.name: Telling Blows
data.description: +1 Fervour per point for each critical strike you land on an Elite or stronger enemy, which keeps the bar up in a long fight where kills are rare.

data.name: Envenom
data.description: Your critical strikes have a 6% chance per point to apply Poison and a 6% chance per point to apply Bleed.

data.name: Fresh Start
data.description: For 3 seconds after you use your movement skill, +2% increased Attack Speed per point.

data.name: Brim
data.description: Each time your Fervour reaches its maximum, your next hit is a critical strike and deals +5% increased damage per point.

data.name: Momentum
data.description: Fervour begins to drain 2 seconds later after your last kill: 6 seconds rather than 4.

data.name: Hunting Ground
data.description: While no enemy is within 20 metres of you, your Fervour does not drain, so a full bar carries from one pack to the next.

data.name: Death's Patience
data.description: Killing an enemy that carries your Poison or Bleed generates +1 Fervour per point.

data.name: Lingering
data.description: +3% increased damage over time damage per point.

data.name: Lasting Wounds
data.description: +4% increased duration per point for Poison and Bleed you apply.

data.name: Deep Venom
data.description: Poison you apply deals +2% increased damage per point. Poison is the long fight's ailment: it pays out in full only against something that survives.

data.name: Festering
data.description: Poison you apply deals +1% increased damage for every 2 points for each second the enemy has stayed poisoned by you without a break, up to 10 seconds.

data.name: Venomed Prey
data.description: Your hits deal +2% increased damage per point to enemies carrying your Poison.

data.name: Open Veins
data.description: Bleed you apply deals +2% increased damage per point.

data.name: Arterial
data.description: +3% increased damage over time frequency per point for Bleed you apply, so more of it lands before a quick kill.

data.name: Hit and Run
data.description: Bleed you apply deals +3% increased damage per point to enemies more than 4 metres from you, which a bleeding enemy is while it chases you.

data.name: Slow Death
data.description: Against a Boss, your damage over time deals +4% increased damage per point.

data.name: Bide
data.description: Against a Boss, your hits have a 3% chance per point to apply Poison.

data.name: Lethal Dose
data.description: Increases to your Critical Strike Multiplier also apply to the damage of Poison and Bleed that your critical strikes apply, at half their value.

data.name: Blood Debt
data.description: When an enemy bleeding from you dies, the damage its Bleed had left to deal is dealt over 2 seconds to the strongest enemy within 10 metres (the enemy Deathmark marked, if you have Deathmark).

data.name: Patient Blade
data.description: Against a Boss, your damage over time ticks also count as kills for filling Fervour, once every 2 seconds.

data.name: Keen Edge
data.description: +3% increased Critical Strike Chance per point.

data.name: Find the Gap
data.description: +4% increased Critical Strike Multiplier per point.

data.name: Read the Giant
data.description: +3% increased damage per point against Bosses, where no kill comes to reset or refill you.

data.name: Open the Throat
data.description: +3% increased Critical Strike Multiplier per point against enemies below 50% health.

data.name: Clean Kill
data.description: Killing an enemy with a critical strike restores 1% of your Maximum Health for every 2 points.

data.name: Last Breath
data.description: +3% increased damage per point against enemies below 30% health.

data.name: From Behind
data.description: +3% increased Critical Strike Chance per point for hits that strike an enemy from behind, including hits a skill counts as struck from behind.

data.name: Wearing Cut
data.description: +1% increased damage for every 2 points for each hit in a row you have landed on the same enemy, up to 10 hits.

data.name: Hunter's Eye
data.description: +2% increased Critical Strike Chance per point against Elite and stronger enemies, and against the enemy Deathmark marked, if you have Deathmark.

data.name: Find the Rhythm
data.description: Against a Boss, each critical strike takes 1 second for every 4 points off your movement skill's remaining cooldown.

data.name: Siege of One
data.description: While you have hit a Boss in the last 2 seconds, Fervour drains 8% slower per point.

data.name: Executioner
data.description: You deal 100% more damage against enemies below 30% health.

data.name: Deathmark
data.description: The strongest enemy within 15 metres is marked. It takes 30% more damage from you, and each critical strike on it gives 5 Fervour. When it dies, the mark moves to the strongest enemy within 10 metres.

data.name: Death by Inches
data.description: Against a Boss, every 10th hit you land counts as killing an Elite or stronger enemy, for Fervour and for everything else that happens when you kill.

data.name: Two Marks
data.description: Requires Deathmark. You mark two enemies.

data.name: Light Feet
data.description: +1% increased Movement Speed per point, doubled for 4 seconds after a kill.

data.name: Arrival
data.description: Hits you land within 1 second after your movement skill ends deal +3% increased damage per point.

data.name: Hunting Leap
data.description: +3% increased range per point for your movement skill, doubled for 2 seconds after a kill, so the jump after a kill reaches the next target.

data.name: Cutting Path
data.description: Your movement skill deals +4% increased damage per point.

data.name: Quick Kill
data.description: Killing an enemy within 2 seconds of using your movement skill generates +1 Fervour per point.

data.name: Blade on Arrival
data.description: +3% increased Critical Strike Chance per point for your movement skill.

data.name: Glancing Cuts
data.description: Enemies your movement skill hits take +2% increased damage per point from you for 4 seconds.

data.name: Through and Through
data.description: Each enemy your movement skill hits generates 1 Fervour for every 2 points.

data.name: Deep Cut
data.description: Your movement skill's hits have a 5% chance per point to apply Bleed. An enemy you leave bleeding behind you has to chase you, and Bleed deals its damage while it moves.

data.name: Borrowed Step
data.description: Your movement skill can be used while it is on cooldown by spending 40 Fervour, reduced by 2 per point.

data.name: Fed Stride
data.description: +5% increased Cooldown Reduction per point for your movement skill while you hold 50 or more Fervour.

data.name: Flicker
data.description: Killing an enemy resets your movement skill's cooldown (with Deathmark: killing the marked enemy also gives 10 Fervour).

data.name: Hollow Step
data.description: Your movement skill passes through enemies and hits each one.

data.name: Twin Step
data.description: Your movement skill has one more charge, and anything that resets its cooldown restores every charge.

data.name: The First Cut
data.description: Unlocks at 25 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: Opening Strike
options.description: Your first hit on an enemy at full health is a critical strike that deals 50% more.

options.name: Afterimage
options.description: A shadow of you stays where your movement skill started and repeats your next attack.

options.name: Quickening
options.description: +3% increased Movement Speed for every 10 Fervour held.

data.name: The Second Cut
data.description: Unlocks at 50 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: Blade Echo
options.description: Each kill throws a spectral blade at the strongest enemy within 10 metres (the enemy Deathmark marked, if you have Deathmark) for 100% weapon damage, so the next fight starts before you arrive.

options.name: Shadow Clone
options.description: Every third kill of an Elite or stronger leaves a clone of you that fights for 5 seconds with your basic attack.

options.name: Honed Edge
options.description: +1% critical strike chance for every 10 Fervour held.

data.name: The Third Cut
data.description: Unlocks at 100 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: Shadow Step
options.description: Your movement skill can target any enemy within 15 metres that you can see and puts you behind it.

options.name: Chain Execution
options.description: A kill makes your next hit within 2 seconds a critical strike.

options.name: Relentless
options.description: Each kill takes 1 second off all your skill cooldowns for every 100 Fervour held.

data.name: The Final Cut
data.description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: Thousand Cuts
options.description: Each kill moves you straight to the strongest enemy within 10 metres (the enemy Deathmark marked, if you have Deathmark) and strikes it.

options.name: Death Sentence
options.description: Your hits kill a non-Boss enemy below 15% health outright; Bosses take double damage from you below 15%.

options.name: Flurry of the Dead
options.description: Your hits strike again once for every 10 Fervour held, up to 10 extra strikes.

data.name: Slip
data.description: After you evade a hit, your next hit within 3 seconds is a critical strike.

data.name: Counterstroke
data.description: +1% Evasion chance per point, and +5% increased Critical Strike Multiplier per point for the critical strike an evasion gives you.

data.name: Nimble
data.description: +3% increased Evasion chance per point.

data.name: Read the Blow
data.description: +1% Evasion chance per point against attacks from Elite and stronger enemies.

data.name: Twice Answered
data.description: Each evasion has a 5% chance per point to give you two critical strikes rather than one.

data.name: Opening Found
data.description: Evading a hit generates 1 Fervour per point, or 2 per point if the attacker is Elite or stronger.

data.name: Riposte
data.description: When you evade a melee hit, you strike the attacker back at once with your basic attack.

data.name: Moving Target
data.description: +3% increased Evasion chance per point while you are moving.

data.name: Tumble
data.description: For 2 seconds after you use your movement skill, +3% Evasion chance per point.

data.name: Slipstream
data.description: For 3 seconds after you evade a hit, +2% increased Movement Speed per point.

data.name: Ever Moving
data.description: While you are moving, your Evasion chance also applies to area damage, at half its value.

data.name: Untouched
data.description: +1% Evasion chance for every 2 points for every full 20 Fervour you currently hold.

data.name: Keep the Count
data.description: Evading a hit adds 1 second for every 3 points to the time before your Fervour begins to drain.

data.name: Sidestep
data.description: Evading a hit takes 1 second for every 5 points off your movement skill's remaining cooldown.
